verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West runs AI tools on client materials, such as brief analysis and contract extraction, and hosts client data in its trademark extranet. Whether client data is used to train AI models is therefore a fair question to ask of the firm. The evidence pack contains no statement on AI training data use, no opt-out, and no contractual commitment on this point. The privacy practice page describes legal services offered to clients, not the firm's own data-use posture.
